{{Top|leg}}
'''Chakton''' was a small village. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[334.556/G7]] was given orders to capture the village. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] Commander [[Thickston Deke]] was tasked with ambushing the Imperial forces.
